extraction.population_detail: Voksne med moderat til alvorlig depressiv lidelse.
extraction.outcome_detail: Gjennomsnittlig vektendring fra baseline til uke 8.
extraction.limitations_text: Åpen oppfølging etter uke 8, og vekt var et sekundært endepunkt.
extraction.source_quote: Mean weight change at week 8 was 1.50 kg greater with sertraline than with placebo.

field_groundings.source_excerpt: Participants were randomised to sertraline 50-200 mg daily or matching placebo for 8 weeks.
field_groundings.justification: Intervensjonsarmen er sertralin i doseintervallet 50-200 mg daglig.

field_groundings.source_excerpt: Participants were randomised to sertraline 50-200 mg daily or matching placebo for 8 weeks.
field_groundings.justification: Komparator er placebo, ikke et annet virkestoff, derfor comparator_kind placebo.

field_groundings.source_excerpt: The secondary outcome was mean change in body weight from baseline to week 8.
field_groundings.justification: Endepunktet er gjennomsnittlig vektendring fra baseline til uke 8.

field_groundings.source_excerpt: A total of 284 participants were randomised and included in the analysis.
field_groundings.justification: Utvalget er 284 randomiserte deltakere, oppgitt som analysert populasjon.

field_groundings.source_excerpt: Participants were randomised to sertraline 50-200 mg daily or matching placebo for 8 weeks.
field_groundings.justification: Måletidspunktet er uke 8, altså 56 dager, som både min og maks.

field_groundings.source_excerpt: Mean weight change at week 8 was 1.50 kg greater with sertraline than with placebo.
field_groundings.justification: Kilden rapporterer mer vektoppgang med sertralin, altså retning increase.

field_groundings.source_excerpt: Mean weight change at week 8 was 1.50 kg greater with sertraline than with placebo.
field_groundings.justification: Tallet er en forskjell mellom to gjennomsnitt, altså mean_difference i kg.

field_groundings.source_excerpt: Mean weight change at week 8 was 1.50 kg greater with sertraline than with placebo.
field_groundings.justification: Estimatet er 1,50 kg, gjengitt med samme skrivemåte som kilden bruker.

field_groundings.source_excerpt: The between-group difference was 1.50 kg (95% CI 0.80 to 2.20).
field_groundings.justification: Konfidensintervallet er 0,80 til 2,20 med 95 prosent nivå.

field_groundings.source_excerpt: Follow-up beyond week 8 was open-label, and weight was a secondary outcome.
field_groundings.justification: Forbeholdene kilden selv oppgir: åpen oppfølging og sekundært endepunkt.

field_groundings.source_excerpt: Baseline characteristics beyond age and sex were not reported for the analysed sample.
field_groundings.justification: Populasjonen er ikke beskrevet nok til en registrert populasjon, derfor not_reported.
